answer: Sybil resistance follows from binding each challenge to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Until the pulse is published, its unpredictable output hides the task seed, so automated swarms cannot pre-compute responses or farm an offline answer library. The task is then deterministically derived with an anchor, while commit-reveal and deadline checks limit equivocation: a jetty of duplicate agents gains no extra value, and each accepted result produces an auditable echo.
